description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various relational and visual concepts evaluated in a benchmark for assessing multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. There are a total of 10 categories shown in the chart. The categories and their respective counts and percentages are as follows: NearSameEntity with 63 (6.34%), ObservationAngle with 126 (12.28%), SimilarMaterial with 106 (10.33%), RelativePosition with 81 (7.90%), MentalitySimilarity with 89 (8.67%), SubEvent with 100 (9.74%), SimilarEvent with 90 (8.77%), UsageSimilarity with 100 (9.65%), Environment with 90 (8.77%), and Layout with 90 (8.77%). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and does not have a legend. The segments are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
